src/.main.jsx: Vite entry point; renders App into #root
src/.App.jsx: Root component; sets up React Router, global providers (auth, cart, notifications)
src/.index.css: Tailwind base/components/utilities imports; CSS custom properties for design tokens

routes/.index.jsx: Centralised route definitions using React Router v6 createBrowserRouter
routes/.ProtectedRoute.jsx: Wraps routes requiring authentication; redirects to /login if no token
routes/.AdminRoute.jsx: Wraps admin routes; checks role claim in JWT; 403 if unauthorised
routes/.GuestRoute.jsx: Redirects authenticated users away from login/register pages

catalogue/.ProductListing.jsx: Page /products — PLP with filters, result counts, pagination
catalogue/.SearchResults.jsx: Page /search — full-text search results with facet filters
catalogue/.ProductDetail.jsx: Page /products/:slug — image, variant picker, tax-inclusive price, add-to-cart

cart/.Cart.jsx: Page /cart — cart item list, totals, proceed to checkout

checkout/.CheckoutAddress.jsx: Step 1 /checkout/address — delivery address form, PIN serviceability check
checkout/.CheckoutPayment.jsx: Step 2 /checkout/payment — payment form with test-mode mock
checkout/.CheckoutReview.jsx: Step 3 /checkout/review — order totals, taxes, promo code entry, shipping charge display
checkout/.GuestPostCheckoutRegister.jsx: Page /checkout/register — optional account creation after guest checkout

auth/.ResetPassword.jsx: Page /reset-password — submit new password with token from URL

account/.AccountOverview.jsx: Page /account — dashboard: profile summary, quick links
account/.OrderHistory.jsx: Page /account/orders — order list with status badges
account/.OrderDetail.jsx: Page /account/orders/:id — status timeline, items, tracking, cancel/return actions
account/.ReturnRequest.jsx: Page /account/orders/:id/return — return request form for eligible items

admin/.AdminDashboard.jsx: Page /admin — aggregated stats and quick-access tiles

orders/.AdminOrderList.jsx: Page /admin/orders — staff order list with status filters
orders/.AdminOrderDetail.jsx: Page /admin/orders/:id — order detail, advance status controls

promotions/.AdminPromotionNew.jsx: Page /admin/promotions/new — create promo code: type, discount, expiry

users/.AdminUserList.jsx: Page /admin/users — user list with role filter

layout/.AppShell.jsx: Outer shell: renders Header, main content slot, Footer
layout/.Header.jsx: Top nav: logo, search bar, cart icon, account menu, notification bell
layout/.AdminShell.jsx: Admin layout shell with sidebar nav gated by AdminRoute
layout/.AdminSidebar.jsx: Sidebar nav for admin panel: links to all admin sections
layout/.PageWrapper.jsx: Applies consistent page padding and max-width constraint

catalogue/.ProductCard.jsx: Grid card: image, name, tax-inclusive price, rating badge
catalogue/.ProductGrid.jsx: Responsive product card grid with skeleton loading states
catalogue/.FilterPanel.jsx: Brand, price-range, rating filter controls with result counts
catalogue/.ActiveFilterBar.jsx: Chips showing applied filters with remove controls
catalogue/.VariantPicker.jsx: Size/colour selector that resolves selection to a SKU
catalogue/.ProductImageGallery.jsx: Main product image display for PDP
catalogue/.PriceDisplay.jsx: Renders tax-inclusive price with optional original price strikethrough
catalogue/.ResultCount.jsx: Displays total results and per-option facet counts

search/.SearchBar.jsx: Input field wired to autocomplete; submits to /search on enter
search/.AutocompleteSuggestions.jsx: Dropdown list of autocomplete suggestions from GET /search/autocomplete

cart/.CartItem.jsx: Single cart line: image, name, SKU variant, qty stepper, remove
cart/.CartSummary.jsx: Subtotal, shipping charge, discount, GST, grand total display
cart/.PromoCodeInput.jsx: Promo code field and apply button; shows applied discount
cart/.EmptyCart.jsx: Empty state illustration and CTA for /products

checkout/.CheckoutStepper.jsx: Step indicator for Address → Payment → Review flow
checkout/.AddressForm.jsx: Reusable delivery address fields with PIN serviceability feedback
checkout/.OrderSummaryPanel.jsx: Compact order totals panel shown during checkout steps
checkout/.PaymentMockForm.jsx: Test-mode payment form: simulate success/failure/pending outcomes
checkout/.ShippingBadge.jsx: Displays free shipping eligibility or ₹49 charge contextually

orders/.OrderCard.jsx: Summary card for order history list: ID, date, status badge
orders/.StatusTimeline.jsx: Visual timeline: Confirmed → Packed → Shipped → Delivered stages
orders/.OrderItemsList.jsx: Tabular list of items in an order with quantities and prices
orders/.TrackingInfo.jsx: Simulated tracking details block on order detail page
orders/.CancelOrderButton.jsx: Cancel CTA with confirmation dialog; only shown when eligible
orders/.ReturnItemSelector.jsx: Checkbox list for selecting eligible items to include in return request

notifications/.NotificationBell.jsx: Header icon showing unread count badge; opens notification dropdown
notifications/.NotificationList.jsx: Scrollable list of notifications with read/unread state
notifications/.NotificationItem.jsx: Single notification row: icon, message, timestamp, mark-read action

auth/.ForgotPasswordForm.jsx: Email input form for password reset request
auth/.ResetPasswordForm.jsx: New password + confirm fields with token from URL param

admin/.StatsCard.jsx: Dashboard KPI tile: metric label, value, trend indicator
admin/.OrderStatusAdvancer.jsx: Dropdown/button to advance order status; role-gated
admin/.ProductForm.jsx: Create/edit product form including SKU variant management
admin/.CategoryForm.jsx: Create/edit category form with parent selector
admin/.PromoCodeForm.jsx: Create/edit promo code: type (percentage/flat), value, expiry date
admin/.ReturnApprovalPanel.jsx: Approve/reject return request controls with refund note
admin/.UserRoleEditor.jsx: Role assignment dropdown for a given user
admin/.AdminDataTable.jsx: Reusable sortable/paginated table for admin list views
admin/.ReportChart.jsx: Wrapper around charting library for consolidated reports

ui/.Button.jsx: Design-system button with variants (primary, secondary, destructive) and sizes
ui/.Input.jsx: Styled text input with label, error message, and accessible focus ring
ui/.Badge.jsx: Status badge: colour + icon + label (never colour alone)
ui/.Modal.jsx: Accessible modal dialog with focus trap and elevation-3 shadow
ui/.ToastContainer.jsx: Renders active toasts; anchored to viewport corner
ui/.Skeleton.jsx: Content-placeholder skeleton shapes for loading states
ui/.Pagination.jsx: Page navigation controls for list views
ui/.EmptyState.jsx: Generic empty-state block with optional CTA
ui/.ErrorBoundary.jsx: React error boundary to catch and display render errors

services/.api.js: Axios instance: base URL, JWT auth header injection, 401 refresh/logout handling
services/.addressesService.js: Calls GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /users/me/addresses; PIN serviceability via addresses service
services/.catalogueService.js: Calls product listing, PLP filters, product detail, categories, brands endpoints; admin catalogue CRUD
services/.paymentsService.js: Calls POST /payments/initiate and /payments/confirm; surfaces mock adapter outcomes
services/.ordersService.js: Calls GET /orders, GET /orders/:id; admin order list, detail, status update
services/.returnsService.js: Calls POST /orders/:id/returns; GET /orders/:id/returns/:rid; admin returns endpoints
services/.promotionsService.js: Calls promo validation endpoint; admin CRUD /admin/promo-codes
services/.adminService.js: Calls admin dashboard stats and reports endpoints; delegates domain calls to domain services

hooks/.useAuth.js: Reads auth context; exposes user, login, logout, isAuthenticated
hooks/.useCart.js: Cart context consumer; exposes cart state, addItem, removeItem, updateQty
hooks/.useNotifications.js: Polls GET /notifications on interval; exposes list, unreadCount, markRead
hooks/.useSearch.js: Manages search query state, calls searchService, debounces autocomplete
hooks/.useFilters.js: Manages multi-filter state for PLP; builds query params for catalogueService
hooks/.usePagination.js: Manages page/limit state for paginated list views
hooks/.useCheckout.js: Manages multi-step checkout form state across Address/Payment/Review steps
hooks/.useOrders.js: Fetches order history and single order detail via ordersService
hooks/.useAddresses.js: Fetches and mutates address book via addressesService
hooks/.useRoles.js: Reads role claims from auth context; exposes hasRole helper
hooks/.useToast.js: Imperative toast trigger hook wired to ToastContainer

context/.AuthContext.jsx: Provides JWT-backed auth state; persists token in httpOnly cookie or localStorage
context/.CartContext.jsx: Provides cart state and mutation actions; merges guest cart on login
context/.NotificationContext.jsx: Provides notification list and unread count to header bell and notification page

types/.auth.types.js: JSDoc/TS-style shapes: User, LoginPayload, RegisterPayload, ResetPayload
types/.catalogue.types.js: Product, SKU, Category, Brand, ProductImage shapes mirroring backend models
types/.promotions.types.js: PromoCode shape with discount type and expiry
types/.address.types.js: Address shape including pin_code and serviceability flag

utils/.formatCurrency.js: Formats amounts as ₹ with locale-aware decimals
utils/.formatDate.js: Formats ISO dates to display strings
utils/.taxUtils.js: Derives GST-inclusive display price; extracts tax portion for breakdown
utils/.shippingUtils.js: Computes shipping charge (₹0 if total ≥ ₹799, else ₹49)
utils/.authUtils.js: Decode JWT claims; check token expiry client-side
utils/.validationSchemas.js: Yup/Zod schemas for all form fields matching backend validator rules
utils/.errorUtils.js: Parses API error responses into user-facing messages
utils/.cn.js: Classname utility (clsx + tailwind-merge) for conditional Tailwind classes

config/.env.js: Reads import.meta.env vars; exports typed constants (API_BASE_URL, etc.)
config/.tokens.css: CSS custom properties mapping all design token names to hex/value literals
config/.tailwind.config.js: Extends Tailwind with design-system colour, spacing, radius, and shadow tokens

assets/.images/: Static image assets (logo, placeholder product image, empty-state illustrations)
assets/.icons/: SVG icon files used throughout the UI for status indicators and navigation

index.html: Vite HTML entry; mounts #root div, references main.jsx
vite.config.js: Vite config: React plugin, path aliases (@/ → src/), proxy /api to backend dev server
tailwind.config.js: Root Tailwind config extending src/config/tailwind.config.js token extensions
postcss.config.js: PostCSS config for Tailwind and autoprefixer
eslint.config.js: ESLint config: React, import-order, accessibility (jsx-a11y) rules
.env.example: Template: VITE_API_BASE_URL and other required frontend env vars
package.json: Dependencies: react, react-dom, react-router-dom, axios, @tanstack/react-query, tailwindcss, clsx, tailwind-merge, yup; devDeps: vite, @vitejs/plugin-react, eslint, jest, @testing-library/react
README.md: Frontend setup, env var reference, design token usage guide, route map
